guide.title: Ana's Overview
guide.text:
Ana is a Healer who excels at manipulating the course of battle from a safe distance.
She is particularly efficient if protected by a solid frontline, since she does not
have any real escape mechanism. Consequently, knowing how to position Ana during a team fight is
crucial when it comes to staying clear of danger, but also when it comes to healing
allied targets from the right angle.

guide.title: Ana's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Relatively low Mana consumption
Counters other Healers
Synergizes with Mages
Provides crowd control
Weaknesses
Weak against dive
Underwhelming mobility
Struggles to heal high-mobility allied Heroes
Unable to dispel Silence effects
Unable to provide Unstoppable frames

guide.title: Ana's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Ana synergizes with
Nano Boost possesses outstanding synergy with
Mages (such as Mephisto) or, more in general,
Heroes who deal the majority of their damage with Abilities and not Basic Attacks.
Even if they can also be used
on their own, Sleep Dart and
Biotic Grenade benefit from allied Heroes who can provide
reliable crowd control with their Basic Abilities
(like E.T.C.) that will make them impossible to miss.
Ana is countered by
Since her self-healing is limited, Ana usually struggles against Heroes
who can ignore her team and dive her instead
(such as Chen with Storm, Earth, Fire).
Abilities that can isolate an enemy Hero (like
Cocoon by Anub'arak) or
disengage (like Mighty Gust by
Falstad) can be used to counter Nano Boost in two
different ways.
While not as effective as the counters that have been mentioned
above, poke is also a decent tool against her, but only if
you can actually do considerable damage to her from high distance
(such as Hanzo).
There are no Healers who can counter Ana,
however, you might prefer going for a Hero who offers utility instead of raw
healing (like Lúcio that can count on Sound Barrier
to support his team without actually healing them).

guide.title: Ana's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Due to her limited survivability, Ana needs to pay special attention on where she positions herself during a team fight.
Healing Dart briefly gives vision on its trajectory, so it can be used to check bushes.
A well-timed offensive Biotic Grenade can easily make a difference between killing an enemy Hero and failing to do so.
Use Sleep Dart to engage, peel, or interrupt when needed.
Activate Shrike when you need Healing Dart or Sleep Dart to pierce.
When a team fight starts, do not wait too much for casting Nano Boost because it lasts 8 seconds.
Before casting Eye of Horus, make sure to be in a safe position otherwise you will have to cancel it early to run away.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Ana's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Ana is a main Healer that fits into a variety of team
compositions, but make sure to have a good target for Nano Boost
to get the most value out of her, usually a Mage (such as
Li-Ming).
Biotic Grenade has the power to heavily counter
most Healers and even some Heroes that belong to different Roles
(for example Arthas with Army of the Dead).

abilities.title: Ana's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Due to her limited survivability, Ana needs to pay special attention on where she positions herself during a team fight.
Healing Dart briefly gives vision on its trajectory, so it can be used to check bushes.
A well-timed offensive Biotic Grenade can easily make a difference between killing an enemy Hero and failing to do so.
Use Sleep Dart to engage, peel, or interrupt when needed.
Activate Shrike when you need Healing Dart or Sleep Dart to pierce.
When a team fight starts, do not wait too much for casting Nano Boost because it lasts 8 seconds.
Before casting Eye of Horus, make sure to be in a safe position otherwise you will have to cancel it early to run away.

abilities.title: Healing Dart
abilities.text:
Healing Dart
(Q)
Ana
Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 (+4% per level) Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.
Healing Dart is a Basic Ability that
requires good aim in order to hit the intended target Hero and heal them.
If there is another
allied Hero in between you and the target Hero that you want to heal
with this Ability, you either change position accordingly or activate
Shrike to make the projectile pierce one allied Hero.
Even if it is rarely useful, it is good to know that Healing Dart will pierce
any allied Hero who has full Health or that is immune to allied effects
(such as Deathwing due to Aspect of Death).

abilities.title: Biotic Grenade
abilities.text:
Biotic Grenade
(W)
Ana
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 (+4% per level) Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 (+4% per level) damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.
If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.
Biotic Grenade is a Basic Ability that completely denies
enemy healing when used on enemy Heroes and amplifies Ana's healing when used
on allied Heroes. You can also use it on both at the same time, if they happen
to be close to each other.
Ana needs to carefully assess the course of battle and decide whether it should be used to
prevent enemy Heroes from healing or to boost her own healing. While there is not
a hard rule, using it on enemy Heroes has a higher impact than using it on allied
Heroes because the healing reduction is stronger than the healing increase.
When used only on allied Heroes, Biotic Grenade's cooldown
is reduced by 3 seconds. When used on Ana alone, Biotic Grenade's
cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds, for a total of 5 seconds of cooldown reduction.

abilities.title: Sleep Dart
abilities.text:
Sleep Dart
(E)
Ana
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.
Cannot be used on Vehicles.
Sleep Dart is a Basic Ability that applies
a Sleep effect to any enemy Hero hit.
While it requires good aim, the best way to use this Ability is to
catch enemy Heroes from the distance so that your team can engage
on them while they are Sleeping. It does not matter that
the damage will wake them up if your team adds crowd control.
Due to Ana not having any form of mobility,
Sleep Dart is best used against enemy melee Heroes, who will
likely try to pressure Ana.
The fact that any Sleep effect
provides at least a 0.5-second Stun allows Ana to contribute to
crowd control chains on the focused
enemy Hero even if the rest of the Sleep effect will go to waste.

abilities.title: Nano Boost
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Nano Boost
(R)
Ana
Heroic
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.
Cannot be used on Ana.
Nano Boost is a Heroic Ability that can easily boost the damage provided by the
Mage in your team (such as Li-Ming) by giving them
Spell Power and cooldown reduction for 8 seconds.
Since it comes with
a relatively long duration, make sure to cast it at the beginning of a team fight rather than keeping
it for too long, but also make sure that the team fight already started or the
enemy team will just disengage and wait for it to expire.

abilities.title: Eye of Horus
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Eye of Horus
(R)
Ana
Heroic
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Charges: 6
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.
Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.
Eye of Horus is a Heroic Ability that allows Ana to heal allies
and damage opponents from anywhere on the battlefield. The projectiles will
pierce allied and enemy Heroes, but not enemy Structures.
The global range comes with a major drawback:
it forces Ana to temporarily take on a stationary position, something that makes
her an easy target to take down if used too close to the action or makes her
late to the second part of the team fight if used from too far.
When activating it, you will get 6 charges ready to use.
When cancelling it, any remaining charge will be lost. Because of this,
you should find a safe position before casting Eye of Horus,
otherwise you will be forced to cancel it early and thus waste some charges.

abilities.title: Shrike
abilities.text:
Shrike
(D)
Ana
Passive
Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.
Aim Down Sights
Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.
Shrike is a Trait that allows Ana to apply Doses on any enemy and
heal herself for a considerable amount based on their number,
something that slightly compensates for the fact that
Healing Dart, her main healing Ability, cannot be self-cast.
Since every Basic Attack does not only refresh Shrike's duration but also deals
damage and healing based on the number of Doses on the target, there is no
reason to stop attacking after reaching the maximum amount of Doses on a given
target. All that said, always maintain a healthy distance from enemy Heroes.
Shrike also has an active component called
Aim Down Sights. While this is active, the range of both
Healing Dart and Sleep Dart is
increased and they pierce through the first valid Hero hit. All of this comes at
the cost of being Slowed down. Even if its tooltip
does not mention it, activating Shrike will trigger a 4-second cooldown on both
Trait and Mount, making her a vulnerable target due to the Slow mentioned above.

talent_pages.text:

Contact Healing
(Level 1)
Ana
Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.
Contact Healing is a good Talent during team fights with several
Heroes—regardless of them being friends or foes—clumping next to each other.
You can use this Talent as a survivability tool against dive
because of the extra healing and/or to punish multiple enemy Heroes
at the same time because of the extra damage.
Being based on Biotic Grenade, this Talent benefits from
Anti-Healer at Level 7 becasue of the bigger area covered
and from Biotic Enhancements at Level 4 because of the cooldown reduction

Slumber Shells
(Level 1)
Ana
Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.
Slumber Shells is a strong Talent that slightly improves
Sleep Dart by making it Slowing
enemy Heroes right after the Sleep ends and by slightly
reducing its cooldown.
The relatively small Slow provided is enough to annoy enemy Heroes
that are trying to reposition, especially if they lack mobility, and allied Heroes
that are trying to damage them, especially if they rely on Basic Attacks.
The cooldown reduction has synergy with Night Terrors
at Level 7 because it allows you to get value from that Talent more often.

(Level 1)
Ana
Increase Shrike's healing by 15%.
Repeatable Quest: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%.
Repeatable Quest: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.
Vampiric Rounds is a weak Quest-based Talent that
provides self-sustain tied to Basic Attacks.
We do not recommend this Talent because you can increase
your own survivability by going for Contact Healing instead,
a Talent that does not require you to unnecessarily expose to farm a Quest
that is supposed to make you a bit harder to kill.

Biotic Grenade to have a slightly lower cooldown and a bit

The small cooldown reduction provided by this Talent
may be useful to better counter Healers
that have Basic Abilities on a cooldown of 13-15 seconds (only
Abundance by Alexstrasza).
The increased bonus healing duration works only when you

Thanks to the cooldown reduction provided,
Biotic Enhancements has synergy with

Overdose is a strong Talent that makes

While they not look that powerful, when you do not have time or space
to use Basic Attacks, the 4 Doses indirectly increase the damage done
via Sleep Dart by 176.
The infinite pierce is useful when you want to ensure that Sleep Dart
connects on the enemy backline (for example when
you want to interrupt Holy Word: Salvation even if more

Debilitating Dart
(Level 4)
Ana
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.
Debilitating Dart is a situational Talent that gives Ana
what she needs the most: self-peeling. If you hit an enemy Hero
with it, they will be Slowed by 50% and deal 50% less damage
for 4 seconds. If you miss enemy Heroes, you will get 8 seconds of cooldown reduction.
Other than being usable on its own or as a follow-up
to allied crowd control,
this additional Active Ability with 20 seconds of cooldown
can be used either before or after Sleep Dart:
When you want to increase your chance to connect Sleep Dart, try hitting the
enemy Hero with Debilitating Dart first because the Slow
provided will help with that.
When you want to increase your chances to connect Debilitating Dart
will hit, try hitting the enemy Hero with Sleep Dart first
because the Sleep will help with that.
In short, use first what you need less and, whether you
hit or miss, follow-up with what you need more.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Ana
talent_pages.text:
✔
Anti-Healer
(Level 7)
Ana
Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.
Anti-Healer is a good Talent that provides a bit more
uptime on the healing reduction by itself and,
more importantly, increases the area covered by Biotic Grenade.
The area extension has synergy with Contact Healing
at Level 1, resulting in more healing and self-sustain
and, even if not that much, Anti-Healer benefits from
Biotic Enhancements at Level 4 because of the cooldown reduction.
The increased healing reduction
duration is not needed and rarely useful. A well-timed Biotic Grenade
lasts long enough to deny the most powerful healing Abilities used on the
focused enemy Hero by themselves or their team.
?
Night Terrors
(Level 7)
Ana
Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.
Night Terrors is a strong Talent that provides both a fair amount of
mobility, something that Ana lacks, and a high amount of
burst damage, something that is extremely powerful
when combined with the healing reduction provided by Biotic Grenade
indirectly acts as burst damage.
The bonus damage will trigger either when the Sleep
lasts for its full duration or when it ends pre-emptively. The damage part is
particularly effective on high-Health enemy Heroes, usually Tanks
and Bruisers.
The bonus Movement Speed is really good to
save Ana from trouble when she has Shrike active and
cannot disable it yet due to the 4 seconds cooldown because it will
basically make you move at normal Movement Speed 2 seconds earlier than usual.
?
Mind-Numbing Agent
(Level 7)
Ana
Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.
Mind-Numbing Agent is a good Talent that allows Ana to reduce both damage and
healing coming from enemy Abilities, but only if you managed to debuff them with Shrike.
Pick this Talent when you want to reduce the damage and healing output
of the enemy frontline Heroes.
Do not see this Talent as a counter to enemy backline Heroes
because you cannot reliably use Basic Attacks on them
and because they are not easy to hit with Sleep Dart
to apply Doses via Overdose at Level 4.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Ana
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Nano Boost
(Level 10)
Ana
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.
Cannot be used on Ana.
Nano Boost is a strong Heroic Ability when your team features
a Mage (such as Kel'Thuzad or even Alarak)
that can benefit from both Spell Power and cooldown reduction.
The best Heroes to use Nano Boost on are:
Alarak,
Cassia,
Cho'Gall,
Chromie,
Falstad,
Gul'dan,
Jaina,
Kael'thas,
Kel'Thuzad,
Li-Ming,
Malthael,
Mephisto,
Nazeebo,
Orphea.
?
Eye of Horus
(Level 10)
Ana
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Charges: 6
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.
Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.
Eye of Horus is a situational Heroic Ability that
can be useful on Maps where it is crucial to
win the offlane and you want a tool to help with that,
or when you do not have a great target for Nano Boost.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Ana
talent_pages.text:
?
Speed Serum
(Level 13)
Ana
Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 1 seconds.
Speed Serum is a situational Talent that can be
used to enable aggressive plays on low-mobility Heroes
(for example Garrosh).
While it
is not a big deal, you should know that the Movement Speed provided by this
Talent can also potentially mess up your aim because the Movement Speed buff
will expire exactly when the next Healing Dart will come
off cooldown.
?
Purifying Darts
(Level 13)
Ana
Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.
Purifying Darts is a good Talent to increase your sustain
healing because Slows are really common and it also works
against Roots.
Pick this Talent when you cannot get enough value from Smelling Salts
or when you really need to remove a Root to save allied Heroes
from death (such as against Kel'Thuzad).
✔
Smelling Salts
(Level 13)
Ana
Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.
Smelling Salts is a strong Talent that gets massive
value against burst compositions, teams
whose main strategy is to Stun an enemy Hero and then
follow-up with burst damage.
Pick this Talent every time you play against a team who has at least a
Stun and some burst damage
to get value out of it because even having 50 Armor
for 2 seconds only once per team fight is a big survivability boost.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Ana
talent_pages.text:
?
Sharpshooter
(Level 16)
Ana
Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.
Sharpshooter is a decent Talent that greatly increases
the amount healed by Healing Dart if you hit allied Heroes
multiple times in a row. You can use this Talent in combat and out of combat
because it does not require enemy Heroes to work.
The main problem with this Talent is that occasionally missing
allied Heroes with Healing Dart will cause you to lose a lot of its value,
although it may be useful to heal up allied Heroes which are quite easy to hit
thanks to their big hitbox and lack of mobility (such as Azmodan).
?
Concentrated Doses
(Level 16)
Ana
Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.
Concentrated Doses is a good Talent that increases
the amount healed by Healing Dart based on
the number of Doses you have applied on enemy Heroes via Shrike.
You can use this Talent in combat but not out of combat
because it requires enemy Heroes to work.
Being based on the number of Doses active on enemy Heroes, this Talent
has synergy with Overdose at Level 4
and Dynamic Optics at Level 20.
✔
Active Reload
(Level 16)
Ana
Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.
Active Reload is a strong Talent that gives Ana a huge amount of
burst healing when needed. It comes with a reasonable cooldown of
60 seconds, allowing Ana to have it available for every important team fight.
The most interesting part about this Talent is that it makes up
for occasionally missing Healing Dart,
so it slightly reduces the chances you will lose a team fight for a single miss.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Ana
talent_pages.text:
✔
Nano Infusion
(Level 20)
Ana
Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.
Nano Infusion is a strong Talent with no downsides
that increases the survivability of whoever you target with Nano Boost
based on the amount of Spell Damage they can deal.
The additional healing it provides can help
the target allied Hero to go for a more aggressive
playstyle to deliver as many empowered Abilities as possible.
?
Deadeye
(Level 20)
Ana
Eye of Horus cooldown reduced to 6 seconds, but it only regains new rounds every 10 seconds. Remaining cooldown is converted to rounds.
For every Hero Eye of Horus hits, increases its damage and healing by 5%. This bonus resets after leaving Eye of Horus or after 4 seconds.
Deadeye is a good Talent that makes Eye of Horus
cancellable without wasting charges by putting it on cooldown for 6 seconds,
and increases its healing and damage each time it hits an allied or enemy Hero.
When picking this Talent, you will get a separate charge
of Eye of Horus for each 10 seconds of cooldown restored so far.
For example, if you pick it when Eye of Horus has 35 seconds
of cooldown remaining, you will get 2 charges and a half.
After that, you will get a charge back every 10 seconds.
We find this Talent more useful when your team and/or the enemy team
tend to play grouped because hitting multiple Heroes with a single shot
will count as a multiple hits, which makes it easily ramp up in value.
?
Armored Stance
(Level 20)
Ana
Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.
Armored Stance is a situational Talent that,
other than slightly increasing her damage done by around 20%,
gives Ana more survivability in the form of
Armor and self-sustain derived
from the additional Shrike's damage being partially
converted to healing.
?
Dynamic Optics
(Level 20)
Ana
Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.
Dynamic Optics is a situational Talent that
gives Ana 50% more damage per second by increasing her
Attack Speed, something that will also increase her
self-sustain thanks to Shrike
converting part of the damage to healing.
